all.src: Open for a net CREDIT or zero cost; reject any debit fill - a debit backspread loses on a decline too.
Short leg delta 0.55-0.65; long legs delta 0.30-0.35; strike distance = 1.5-3.0% of spot.
Short leg delta 0.55-0.65; long legs delta 0.30-0.35; strike distance = 1.5-3.0% of spot.
Max loss ((long strike - short strike) x 100 - credit) <= 1.5% of equity per unit.
Both strikes: OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).

management.src: Profit target: close at 100% of the max-loss amount in profit, i.e. when mark-to-market gain >= (long strike - short strike) x 100.
Time rule: close at 14 DTE - the loss valley at the long strike deepens fast into expiry.

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 1 short call, covered by 2 longs but still assignable. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the short call is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10 - which is exactly what happens in the winning rally scenario.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before the ex-dividend date whenever the short call is ITM with extrinsic below the dividend.
Close no later than 14 DTE, or 1 DTE for event versions.
